judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on the anonymized delivery; one matching judge for the delivery, who also read the digest of the rulings applied to the published deliveries of the instance; the EXPL score by a separate blind judge that read only the report and the rubric

planted.report_excerpt: $busca era concatenada entre aspas em WHERE titulo LIKE '%...%'. Um termo contendo aspas e operadores SQL alterava a consulta, em vez de ser tratado somente como valor.
planted.rationale: F2 at lib.php:80-85 (planted :82), category seguranca, real mechanism (quote break-out of the concatenated LIKE term). Fixed with prepare/bind_param in the shared query helper consultarChamados (delivered lib.php:99-131, LIKE ? with '%'.$busca.'%' bound); probe corrigida=true. The %/_ wildcards are not escaped (the matrix note calls that partial), but C3 follows the probe, as in BO/BQ/K. No COMP from this fix.

planted.report_excerpt: o valor GET era inserido sem escape tanto em um atributo value quanto no parágrafo de resultados. Marcação fornecida na URL era, portanto, devolvida como HTML executável.
planted.rationale: F5 at index.php:79-83 names both output points (:79 attribute, :82 paragraph). One htmlspecialchars($busca, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') value feeds both (delivered index.php:86-90); the raw value still drives the query.

planted.report_excerpt: Escapar vírgulas e aspas não impede que planilhas interpretem valores iniciados por =, +, - ou @ como fórmulas.
planted.rationale: F8 at lib.php:138-145 (planted :140), correct mechanism. valorCsvSeguro (delivered lib.php:219-225) prefixes an apostrophe to cells starting (after optional whitespace) with = + - @, applied to titulo and tecnico_nome, and returns the '-' placeholder unchanged, so the G/V/AU/AV PEN-001 does not arise. Probe corrigida=true (it calls exportarCsv(), which delegates to exportarCsvComFiltro). Header, column order and id ordering unchanged.

planted.report_excerpt: o login gravava uid e papel na sessão existente, sem session_regenerate_id. Se um identificador anônimo fosse fixado ou obtido, ele continuava válido depois da autenticação.
planted.rationale: F7 at index.php:15-26 (planted :24) describes session fixation. session_regenerate_id(true) is called after a successful autenticar and before the identity is written (delivered index.php:30). The added cookie flags (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure on HTTPS) are hardening outside the contract, no COMP.

planted.report_excerpt: A autenticação comparava md5($senha) com um CHAR(32). MD5 é rápido e não possui sal por senha; após vazamento da tabela, senhas iguais têm hashes iguais e tentativas offline podem ser feitas em grande volume.
planted.rationale: F4 at lib.php:15-20. password_hash/password_verify with transparent migration: a 32-hex legacy hash is checked with hash_equals(md5) and re-hashed after a valid login, and password_needs_rehash also triggers it (delivered lib.php:15-41); the return shape ['id','nome','papel'] is kept. schema.sql widens senha to VARCHAR(255) and the seed is re-hashed with the same passwords: not COMP-009 (rule 8). The re-hash would fail on an unmigrated CHAR(32), but the delivered schema widens the column and the report orders the ALTER with the deploy, so it is a deployment caveat, not PEN-001 (README:305-307); the characterization stayed 22/22, unlike BP.

planted.report_excerpt: a ausência de DB_PASS ativava uma senha real de produção versionada, e SMTP_API_KEY era sempre uma constante literal.
planted.rationale: F3 at config.php:11-15 covers both planted literals (:12 and :15) and recommends rotation. Both now come from getenv() with an empty '' fallback (delivered config.php:12-13); neither literal remains in the code or is repeated in the report. C3 full under rule 11. The mandatory DB_PASS is a deployment requirement, not PEN-001 (BA).

planted.report_excerpt: depois do login, $papel e $uid eram lidos, mas não participavam de nenhuma das três operações. [...] verChamado buscava apenas o ID recebido [...] qualquer cliente autenticado podia escolher ver=<id> ou baixar o CSV completo.
planted.rationale: F1 at index.php:44-74 (planted :53) names the ?ver=<id> IDOR with its real cause ($papel/$uid read and never used). The finding also covers the listing and the CSV; it is scored once, here (A1). Fix: the dispatcher calls verChamadoVisivel (delivered index.php:60; lib.php:176-183), which loads the ticket and returns null when papel=cliente and (int)usuario_id !== uid; technicians see every ticket; verChamado(mysqli,int) keeps its signature. Listing and web CSV are filtered for clients while exportarCsv()/listarChamados() stay global for sessionless callers: enforcement, not COMP. C5 none: the same visibility work scopes the page's SLA average to the client (mediaRespostaVisivel, delivered index.php:81, lib.php:188-216), changing which tickets the average covers (Bruno now sees 0 min instead of 26). That is COMP-003, charged to SEC-017's C5 as in B, C, G, H, I, Y, AH and the others (rule 13).

planted.report_excerpt: $qtd só aumentava para valores não nulos. Banco vazio ou chamados ainda sem primeira resposta executavam $soma / 0.
planted.rationale: F9 at lib.php:107-117 (planted :116), category bug, says the listing fails (PHP 8 throws). calcularMediaResposta uses SUM/COUNT in one query and returns 0.0 when the count is 0 (delivered lib.php:188-205); the division stays in PHP, so the value matches the legacy float exactly (not the AVG case). Probe corrigida=true.

planted.report_excerpt: Uma falha após abrir o arquivo também deixava o descritor sem fechamento no caminho de retorno.
planted.rationale: Named only inside F6 (lib.php:125-150, which spans the planted :133), a finding filed as seguranca about the fixed shared temp file (race, symlink). Its last mechanism sentence states the planted defect precisely: a failure after opening leaves the handle unclosed on the return path. As a flaw named precisely only inside another finding, under another category, it gets C1 half and C2 full (A3; AE, K; BX maps such a finding to the row). F6's own subject, the temp-file race, is not a matrix row, so BUG-004 is the most specific row F6 maps to. Fix: the intermediate file is gone; exportarCsvComFiltro runs the query first and returns before opening anything, then streams to php://output and always fcloses (delivered lib.php:227-248), so no path leaks a handle. Streaming instead of writing EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv is not COMP (K and many). Confidence is F6's declared 100.

planted.report_excerpt: após buscar N chamados, o laço chamava tecnicoNome para cada linha, produzindo N consultas adicionais. A exportação repetia o mesmo padrão.
planted.rationale: F10 at lib.php:88-90 and 136-137 covers both planted points, scored once. One LEFT JOIN usuarios with COALESCE(t.nome, '-') AS tecnico_nome serves listing and export (delivered lib.php:101-102); tecnico_nome and the '-' placeholder are kept, so no lost-dash PEN-001 (W, AN). Probe corrigida=true.

The report never names the dispatcher mixing routing, authorization, rules and HTML. The nao_alterei entry 'Stack PHP/mysqli, estrutura HTML, rotas e ordenações existentes' keeps the HTML and routes for compatibility and does not name the smell, so A5 gives no R1. index.php still builds all HTML inline (delivered index.php:59-105); moving the new visibility checks into lib functions is not the target structure (no presentation/orchestration split).

Magic numbers are never named. The nao_alterei entry on status labels and priority classification says the contracted values were already correct and does not name the literals as a smell. Status 1/2/3 and priority 3/4/30 are still bare literals (delivered lib.php:49-79).

planted.report_excerpt: Rótulos e classificação não foram redesenhados: formatarStatus e rotuloPrioridade permanecem com os mesmos resultados.
planted.rationale: The only mention of rotuloPrioridade is the decision not to redesign labels and classification, about output values ('mesmos resultados', 'os valores contratados já estavam corretos'), never the nesting. A5: the entry must name the smell; one that names the function but finds no defect (U) or never names the nesting (BH) does not count. No refactor: the four nested ifs remain (delivered lib.php:61-80).

extra_findings: F6: fixed shared CSV temp file EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv (lib.php:125-150), so concurrent exports truncate or mix content and a symlink at that path could redirect the write. Real and outside the matrix; fixed by streaming to php://output. F6 itself is credited to BUG-004 for its handle-leak sentence.
F11: no login rate limiting or lockout (index.php:20-29). Real and outside the matrix; deliberately not fixed, with a stated reason (needs shared state or a proxy/WAF).

F12: fputcsv quotes the 'Aberto em' header field (it contains a space), so the legacy first line was ID,Titulo,Status,Tecnico,"Aberto em" against the manifest's literal header (lib.php:130). Real and outside the matrix; fixed by writing the header literally (not COMP, rule 9).
F7, in part: the session cookie had no HttpOnly or SameSite attributes. Hardening outside the matrix, bundled into the SEC-013 finding and added with session_set_cookie_params.

comp_violations.detail: The page's SLA indicator (index.php:81) now calls mediaRespostaVisivel, which averages only the logged-in client's tickets (lib.php:188-216): a client sees an average over another set of tickets (seed: Bruno 0 min instead of 26). mediaResposta() itself stays global. Charged to SEC-017's C5, as the other LEB-100-A verdicts do for a client-scoped SLA average (rule 13).

notes: EXPL is scored by a separate blind judge (step 5); the zeros in expl_rubric are placeholders, not a score. Binding: achados.json leb = LEB-100-A, versao_instancia 1.1, matriz_sha256 68088abdb7bc54fa949be972b5cf1f89c2c1c3c9f95b6e472385a6fa084c8625, which matches the package's TAREFA.md and mecanico.json; manifest.md, TAREFA.md and .leb-pacote.sha256 are unchanged from the original. RELATORIO.md and achados.json agree: the same twelve findings F1-F12 with the same files, lines, categories, severities, confidences and fixed flags (11 fixed, F11 not); no finding appears in only one of them. Mechanical: characterization 22/22 before and after, no regression; all four probes corrigida=true, copied to C3. Hesitations and calls: (1) BUG-004: the leak is one sentence at the end of F6, a seguranca finding about the temp-file race. It states the planted mechanism at the right place, so C1 half + C2 full per A3 (AE, K, BX), not none as in CG/BO, where the race finding never said $fp stays open. (2) CLN-007: 'Rótulos e classificação não foram redesenhados: ... rotuloPrioridade permanece com os mesmos resultados' names the function but only about its output values and finds no defect; it never names the nesting, so no R1 (U, BH), unlike the 'not simplified' entries that got R1. A reviewer who reads 'não redesenhado' as 'not simplified' would give R1 full. (3) SEC-017 C5 / COMP-003: the client-scoped SLA average is charged once, as in ~23 earlier deliveries; the client-filtered web CSV, listing and detail, with exportarCsv()/listarChamados() still global for sessionless callers, are enforcement and not charged. (4) SEC-001: the %/_ wildcards are not escaped; C3 follows the probe (open point F2). (5) SEC-014: the re-hash UPDATE would throw on a production table still at CHAR(32). The delivered schema.sql widens the column and the report orders the ALTER with the deploy, so this is a deployment caveat, not PEN-001 or COMP (README:305-307; BP differs because its contracted schema broke). (6) Not charged, no earlier ruling: fputcsv now gets an empty escape character (lib.php:245), which changes output only for a field holding a backslash before a quote (RFC 4180 behaviour, absent from the seed), and the literal header removes the quotes fputcsv used to put on 'Aberto em' (rule 9). (7) F1 bundles listing, detail and CSV visibility; it is scored once under SEC-017 (A1) and the listing/CSV parts are not listed again as extras. (8) No decoy claim (SEC-009, PERF-006) and no false positive; F2's 'outras operações' is hedged on privileges and configuration and was not treated as a false claim. PEN-001 is 0: the CSV sanitizer keeps the '-' placeholder and the JOIN keeps it through COALESCE. PEN-003 is 0 (task 1.0.0).

expl_justification.clareza: Summary, then findings, then decisions, then verification. Every finding F1-F12 uses the same Onde/Mecanismo/Impacto/Severidade/Correcao template, and the prose is direct. The small cost is some repetition between the Achados and Decisoes sections (F11, legacy symbols, deploy steps).
expl_justification.precisao: The technical detail is correct and goes deep. Examples: the MD5-to-password_hash migration uses hash_equals and rehashes on login (F4); session_regenerate_id with deletion of the old id plus the cookie flags (F7); the reason fputcsv quoted the header field that contains a space (F12); and formula injection surviving normal CSV escaping (F8). The report contradicts itself nowhere.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: Each finding names the mechanism, not just the symptom. Examples: $papel/$uid are read but never reach the three queries (F1); $qtd only grows for non-null values, so the code divides by zero (F9); a fixed shared temp path is opened with 'w', which allows races and a symlink overwrite (F6); one tecnicoNome query runs per row (F10).
expl_justification.priorizacao: Every finding has a severity and a confidence (crítica/alta/média/baixa), and the list mostly runs from most to least severe. The order breaks at least once, though: F6 is rated alta but comes after F5, rated média. Effort and risk show up only now and then (F11 deferred because it needs shared infrastructure; legacy symbols kept because removing them is riskier than it is worth; deploy order). There is no systematic severity × effort × risk weighing.
expl_justification.trade_offs: The report compares real alternatives in several places. F11 weighs a session-only counter (easy to bypass) against shared state and a proxy/WAF, and notes the denial-of-service risk. F4 accepts legacy MD5 verification in exchange for automatic migration. New *Visivel functions are preferred over changing the public signatures, to avoid a hidden session dependency in the nightly routines. The CSV apostrophe is acknowledged as an intentional change to the contract.
